title: Ordered Čech chain map induced by an inverse-image coefficient map
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $I$ be an index set, and let $U_i\subseteq X$, $V_i\subseteq Y$ be open families, not necessarily covers. Assume $V_y=\bigcap_l V_{y(l)}\subseteq g^{-1}U_y$, where $U_y=\bigcap_l U_{y(l)}$, for every $y:\{0,\ldots,k\}\to I$ and every $k\geq0$. Let $F,G$ be abelian sheaves on the open-set sites of $X,Y$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and let $\alpha:F\to g_*G$ be a natural map of their underlying presheaves. The ordered Čech complex has cochains $\check C^k(U,F)=\prod_y F(U_y)$ and differential the alternating sum of restrictions along deletion of one index. Define the real additive chain map $A_\alpha:\check C^\bullet(U,F)\to\check C^\bullet(V,G)$ by $(A_\alpha x)_y=\operatorname{res}_{V_y}^{g^{-1}U_y}(\alpha_{U_y}(x_y))$. Naturality and restriction composition prove that these components commute with every alternating differential; no comparison or existence theorem chooses any data.

def cechInverseImageCochainMap
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : F.obj ⟶ (Opens.map g.base).op ⋙ G.obj) :
    (TopCat.Sheaf.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F ⟶
      (TopCat.Sheaf.cechComplexFunctor V).obj G
